definition: Outstanding notional of interest rate derivatives of LIFE insurers, entirely FRAs (ISDA whitepaper p34 pdf; footnote 88: Acies analysis of financial statements of all life insurers). Secondary source.

Traders' estimate of debt linked to bank-insurer forward-style trades (banks buy long bonds and sell to insurers later). Not insurer notional; no as-of date; no primary source cited (appears to be a wire report). Secondary/low precision.
Rates derivative contracts insurers are in talks to convert into bond forwards (Bloomberg-sourced reporting). Planned conversion volume; not an audited outstanding stock; no as-of date. Secondary.

The three figures differ in date, scope and concept and are NOT directly comparable. Paper 1 H2 benchmark (INR 3.5 trn) is therefore a press estimate; see prereg amendment if the definition is judged unusable.
